title: Review permissive cors
why: Wildcard origins can expose authenticated or sensitive APIs to untrusted sites.
suggestion: List trusted origins explicitly and avoid wildcard credentials.
limitations: Explicit allow_origins lists beginning with a wildcard literal are reported only at executable code locations; comments, docstrings, and quoted examples are excluded while origin strings are retained.
Framework wrappers, generated routes, runtime registrations, and external infrastructure cannot be resolved.
